text: Mid-term assessment,
part 1, speaking.
Koi buufen,
read aloud and answer.
In the gardening club, we have a sunflower.
It has a long stem and big leaves.
Its flower looks like the sun.
We also play traditional games,
like Chinese yo-yo, in our garden.
Sometimes after running and playing,
I feel hot and need to drink water to stay healthy.
